ceu: ✦ The square between the Sun and Uranus

s.k: Today the other person is your mirror.
t: With the Moon in your house of partnerships, the balance between giving and receiving is at stake. Look for the middle ground.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between routine and conversations. A short pause avoids a long argument.
s.d: Listen to the end before you answer.

s.k: Organise the day and the day will organise you.
t: The Moon asks for method and care with the details. A small adjustment to your routine makes a difference.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between romance and money. Today's challenge is teaching you patience.
s.d: Lay out tomorrow's clothes and bag tonight.

s.k: Your heart wants a celebration and a little light.
t: A day to shine without fear. What you do with passion is contagious to those around you.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between family and your image. Do not take to heart what has nothing to do with you.
s.d: Plan a romantic moment, even a simple one.

s.k: The heart of the day is at home.
t: The Moon passes through your area of home and family. It is a day to be close to those who give you roots.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between conversations and your inner life. Put off big decisions until the dust settles.
s.d: Make your bedroom a place of rest: less clutter, more peace.

s.k: One conversation can change the course of the day.
t: Today your mind is quicker and more curious. Use it to settle pending matters in writing or in person.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between money and friendships. Do one thing at a time and the day will calm down.
s.d: Write an idea down on paper before it slips away.

s.k: Look at what you have, not at what you lack.
t: With the Moon in your house of values, you crave comfort and concrete things. Choose with your head before you spend.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your image and your career. You do not have to choose right now: look for the middle ground.
s.d: Make a list of what you have already achieved and give thanks.

s.k: A day to put yourself first.
t: Today the Moon visits your sign and puts your energy in the spotlight. People notice you more, so show your best side.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your inner life and your horizons. Be firm, but without hardening your heart.
s.d: Look at yourself in the mirror with the tenderness you show the people you love.

s.k: A day to recharge on the inside.
t: A day for prayer, meditation or a simple walk on your own. The peace you find today stays with you.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between friendships and intimacy. Breathe before reacting, because haste is the worst adviser today.
s.d: Sleep a little longer, if you can.

s.k: Share a dream with someone who believes in it.
t: The Moon passes through your area of friends and projects. Good company gives you energy today.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your career and relationships. If something goes wrong, it is just an adjustment and not the end.
s.d: Do a friend a favour without expecting anything in return.

s.k: Your goals ask for a firm step.
t: Today work and reputation carry emotional weight. Praise or criticism touches you more than usual.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between your horizons and routine. Tension is a sign of growth, not of failure.
s.d: Say no to a task that is not yours.

s.k: A day to learn and broaden your horizons.
t: With the Moon in your house of wisdom, the day asks for meaning: ask yourself where you want to go, not just how.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between intimacy and romance. Say what you feel calmly and without blaming.
s.d: Accept an invitation that is different from usual.

s.k: Trust is the word of the day.
t: The Moon touches intimacy and strong bonds. Open up to those who deserve it, and only to those who deserve it.
The square between the Sun and Uranus creates some tension between relationships and family. Hear both sides before you decide.
s.d: Speak frankly about a matter you keep avoiding.
